message.content:
**Impression:** A high-quality, cinematic dark-mode landing page with strong visual hierarchy and consistent styling, though it suffers from a few minor alignment and spacing inconsistencies in the footer and navigation.

| Location | Issue | Severity |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Footer (Bottom Center)** | The three feature items (icons + text) are not perfectly horizontally aligned; the text baselines appear slightly staggered relative to each other. | P3 |
| **Header (Top Right)** | The "EN" language toggle is misaligned vertically with the main navigation links, sitting slightly lower than the Arabic menu items. | P3 |
| **Hero Section (Right Side)** | The vertical spacing (margin) between the sub-headline text block and the button group ("ابدأ مجاناً") is noticeably larger than the spacing between the headline and the sub-headline, creating a slight visual disconnect. | P3 |
| **Hero Image (Left Side)** | The glassmorphism container holding the 3D cubes has slightly inconsistent corner radii (the bottom-left radius appears subtly sharper or different than the others). | P3 |
| **Buttons (Bottom Right)** | The internal padding of the secondary button ("شاهد العرض") is slightly less than the primary button ("ابدأ مجاناً"), causing the text to sit higher within its container. | P3 |
